title: Orders Data Contract
description: Formalized Data Contract between Order Service (Producer) and Analytics/Data Platform (Consumers).

id.description: Unique positive identifier of the order.

customer_id.description: Unique identifier of the customer placing the order.

amount_cents.description: Order total monetary value in minor units (cents). Must be non-negative.

currency.description: Strict 3-character uppercase ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the order.

created_at.description: Order creation timestamp in strict UTC ISO-8601 format.

freshness.description: SLA freshness window: payloads older than 24 hours relative to event receipt are rejected as stale.
